pr_title: ADR-0112 wave-A: webhook-receiver kernel + app (HMAC + dedup + router)
summary: F5 review of PR #7 found passing PR checks but production-critical reliability gaps in the webhook receiver: HMAC verification is fail-open when no secret is loaded, HTTP mode does not durably append delivery outcomes, and the routing path has shallow HTTP/restart coverage. Highest severity: BLOCKER.

findings.issue: HMAC verification is fail-open when no secret is loaded. Both the HTTP handler and simulated dispatch only verify when `!skip_hmac` and `Some(secret)` are true; if the SecretReference/file fallback is missing, unsigned GitHub webhook payloads are accepted unless the operator explicitly notices the missing secret.
findings.remediation: Make missing secret a startup/configuration error whenever skip_hmac is false. Add tests for HTTP and simulate modes proving missing secret + skip_hmac=false rejects, while missing secret + explicit skip_hmac=true remains local-test-only and visibly logged.

findings.issue: HTTP mode checks the in-memory delivery log snapshot but never appends accepted, routing_failed, agent_invocation_failed, or deduplicated outcomes back to the canonical delivery log. Dedup state therefore resets on process restart and first deliveries are not durably auditable.
findings.remediation: Append each delivery outcome atomically before returning the HTTP response, reload or lock the log per request, and add a redelivery-after-restart regression test proving a repeated GitHub delivery is deduplicated after process restart.

findings.issue: The tests exercise pure dispatch and simulated routing, but the app-level HTTP path is where signature headers, wall-clock timestamps, dedup lookup, router matching, and persistence should compose. The current tests pass while the missing-secret and no-append HTTP defects remain uncovered.
findings.remediation: Add app HTTP integration tests that post signed/unsigned payloads with temp delivery logs and assert status code, persisted log row, dedup on second post, and restart behavior. Include routing-failed and malformed payload cases.
